name: Cultist: Call of N'Zoth extends Darkwither's duration natively (#1553)
contract: 300306 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue=1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), EffectBasePoints=8999/DieSides=1 giving a flat +9000 ms (SpellInfo.cpp:489), classmask dword1=2097152 (bit21). Verified against Spell.dbc: 800446 'Darkwither' has SpellFamilyFlags dword1=2097152 (bit21 set) and DurationIndex=8, whose SpellDuration.dbc row gives a finite 15000 ms base. Player::IsAffectedBySpellmod (Player.cpp:10202) only rejects SPELLMOD_DURATION when the affected spell's GetDuration() == -1 (permanent); Darkwither's is finite, so the guard never fires and the mod applies: 15000 + 9000 = 24000 ms, matching the tooltip's '+9 sec' exactly. No script needed.
